one_liner: Web data platform providing proxies, web scraper APIs, and SERP APIs for large-scale public web data collection.

auth.notes: Search results describe two methods: 'API Access with an API key' (a hashed token, optionally with expiration) or 'Native Access with proxy username and password' (basic-style credentials for the proxy network). Page seen in search results but not directly fetched, so quote omitted.

access.evidence_quote: Every new account includes 5,000 free requests per month.
access.notes: Web Scraper/SERP APIs use pay-per-result pricing per brightdata.com/products; a default API key is created automatically on account signup.

api.notes: Official MCP server exposes 69 tools per search results (web search, scraping, structured extraction, browser automation), running on the Web Unlocker API.

verdict.rationale: API key auth with automatic account provisioning, a free monthly request allowance, and an official MCP server.
